mapper.select: SELECT param_code, param_name, param_value FROM T_LHFL_SCHEDULE_PARAMS p where mix_area = (SELECT max(mix_area) FROM T_LHFL_SCHEDULE_PARAMS p1 WHERE mix_area in #{mixArea} AND p1.del_flag = '0' AND p.param_code=p1.param_code) and p.mix_area in #{mixArea} and p.del_flag = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT PARAM_CODE, PARAM_VALUE, PARAM_NAME FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_CODE ELSE a.PARAM_CODE END PARAM_CODE, CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_NAME ELSE a.PARAM_NAME END PARAM_NAME, CASE WHEN b.PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN b.PARAM_VALUE ELSE a.PARAM_VALUE END PARAM_VALUE FROM T_SCHEDULE_PARAMS A LEFT JOIN T_SCHEDULE_PARAMS B ON A.Param_Code = b.param_code AND b.mix_area = #{mixArea} AND b.del_flag = 0 where a.mix_area = '0' AND a.DEL_FLAG = '0' ) as TSP WHERE PARAM_CODE IS NOT NULL
